posts.title: Building a backyard office, the build and cost breakdown
posts.description: I wrote up my experience building a backyard office because I wish I had come across more articles like this when planning my build. I hope this post helps you

posts.title: Everyone is designing with AI, not for it
posts.description: We focus on how people are designing and building with AI. I rarely read about how AI is changing “what” people are designing and building.
